card.text: A young giant of about 14 Jupiter masses, circled by a dusty disc that JWST detected.

sources.label: Hoch et al. 2025
sources.quote: the first circumplanetary disk silicate emission around its sibling planet, YSES-1 b

introduction.text: YSES 1 b orbits its young Sun-like star about 160 au out. GRAVITY positions and a radial velocity against the star gave it its first full orbit in 2025.

sources.label: Roberts et al. 2025
sources.quote: This represents the first full orbit fit for the system

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing with its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured.
